title: clsx
standardAlternative: A filter(Boolean) and join(" ") over the class names, with Object.entries for conditional ones.

tests.match: ^upstream:test/(index\.js › (strings|numbers|arrays|arrays \(nested\)|arrays \(variadic\)|functions)( \(variadic\))?$|classnames\.js › \(compat\) (joins arrays of class names|supports an array|joins array arguments|handles multiple array|handles arrays that include (falsy|arrays)|handles arrays that are empty|handles nested arrays))

^upstream:test/(index\.js › (objects|objects \(variadic\)|arrays \(no `push` escape\))$|classnames\.js › \(compat\) (keeps object keys|supports heterogenous|should be trimmed|returns an empty string|handles all types of truthy))

excluded.reason: Tests the separate clsx/lite entry point. A submission is one module, which cannot export both the full clsx and the string-only lite clsx under the same names, so lite is outside the Create API and not vendored.

notes: Upstream runs its tests with uvu 0.5.4 (`uvu -r esm test`). uvu's runner prints only per-file totals, so shims/uvu.mjs maps uvu's test() and suite() onto node:test to report one TAP point per test; assertions still use the real uvu/assert 0.5.4. The esm loader is unnecessary on Node 24.
